impact: A leadership shock at the AI bellwether threatens Wednesday's rebound; MU, DRAM and SNXX are most exposed, and NBIS reports before Thursday's open with options pricing about ±14%. A quick, orderly succession could limit the damage.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday evening that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang and was meeting to decide his future; Bloomberg said the board has worked with an outside firm on successors and could name an interim chief. No decision had been announced. Nvidia fell about 8% to 10% after hours to around $160, and Nasdaq 100 futures dropped about 1%. The reports follow disclosures of two extramarital affairs, one with a woman US officials believe was a Chinese spy.
title: Nvidia board weighs ousting CEO Huang; NVDA ~-9% after hours
